title: Sample Plate Filling 96 Wells to 384 Well Plate
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates the transfer of PCR mix and samples from up to four 96-well elution plates to a 384-well plate. It follows a specific format detailed in the image below. Columns from the 96 well elution plates correspond to specific wells on the 384 well plate. Each elution plate contains a control that is also transferred into the 384-well plate. steps.title: Verify equipment and reagents
steps.instruction: Ensure a P20 multichannel pipette is mounted on the OT‑2 and have ready: Opentrons 96‑filter tip rack (20 µL), ThermoFisher 384‑well optical PCR plate, Molgen 96‑well elution plates, Opentrons NEST 12‑well reservoir, and access to the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (version 4.0.0 or later).

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the protocol customization fields, select the mount position for the P20 multichannel pipette, enter the total number of samples across up to four 96‑well elution plates (maximum 384 samples), set the PCR‑mix transfer volume (default 7.5 µL) and sample transfer volume (default 5 µL), and specify the sample aspiration height above the well bottom. Remember that each column of a 96‑well plate maps to a specific well on the 384‑well plate and each elution plate contains a control that will be transferred; if fewer than four plates are used, add the missing controls manually to the corresponding wells.

substeps.instruction: Specify aspiration height above well bottom.

steps.title: Generate and download protocol
steps.instruction: After all parameters are entered, click “Download your protocol” to save the generated Python protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the OT‑2 Run App, choose “Upload your protocol”, and select the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map: place the 384‑well PCR plate in slot 1, the 96‑filter tip rack in slot 2, the up‑to‑four 96‑well elution plates in their designated slots, and the 12‑well reservoir in its slot. Verify that the P20 pipette is attached.

substeps.instruction: Place each 96‑well elution plate in its assigned slot.
Place 12‑well reservoir in its assigned slot.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, run the calibration routine for the tip rack, each plate, and the P20 pipette, following the on‑screen prompts and using calibration tips if required.

steps.title: Execute transfer run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the automated transfer of PCR mix and samples from the 96‑well elution plates to the 384‑well plate according to the defined column‑to‑well mapping.
